seo.title: Book Meghalaya Adventure Honeymoon Tour - Kajaawa
seo.description: Have a romantic time along with adventure by booking our Meghalaya Adventure Honeymoon Tour where you will have lots of fun-filled memories.

items: Hotel
Transportation
Breakfast
Camping
Sightseeing
Activities

content.text: You will have one of the the best time of your life by booking this Meghalaya Travel Package. At the start of this tour, you will visit the beautiful Umiam Lake and explore the amazing culture of Shillong and its people. Visit the Romantic view of Shillong, Mawlynnong and Dawki. Enjoy boating on the crystal clear Umngot River and spend your lovely time admiring the beauty of its beauty. Have many adventurous activities with your loved one at the riverside of Shnongpdeng.

main.title: Tour Highlights
items: Spend quality time with your loved one at Umiam Lake
Take a tour of Shillong and its surroundings
Trek about 3500 steps to see the amazing Double Decker Root Bridge
Take in the sights and sounds of Cleanest Village and Cleanest River
At Shnongpdeng's riverside, spend the night camping with a bonfire
Snorkelling, zip-lining, kayaking, and cliff jumping are among activities that can be done with your loved one
Spend some quality time with your dearest on the Brahmaputra Cruise in the evening

days.title: Day 1 : Arrival at Guwahati
items: Pickup from the Guwahati Airport or Railway Station.
Guwahati Shillong road trip is beautiful with many amazing scenic views.
Stop at Umiam Lake if you want to spend some time with your loved one.
Check into your accommodation and rest for a while.
In the evening, take a stroll around the police market and do some shopping.

days.title: Day 2 : Double Decker Root Bridge Trek
items: It's time to move for an adventurous day in Cherrapunji.
Trek to Double Decker Root Bridge which is about 3500 steps to Nongriat
Refresh yourself with the cool water which flows beneath the bridge.
In the evening, transfer to your hotel.

days.title: Day 3 : Mawlynnong and Dawki Visit
items: Transfer to Mawlynnong Village, one of Asia's cleanest village.
After a 10-minute journey from Mawlynnong, see the Living Root Bridge at Riwai Village.
Later head to Dawki and visit the Indo-Bangladesh Border.
In Dawki, go boating on the crystal clear Umngot River.
Transfer to the Shnongpdeng Campsite, which is located near Dawki.
Enjoy the special bonfire which is specially arranged for you near the river.

days.title: Day 4 : Adventure in Shnongpdeng to Guwahati
items: After checking out of the camp, head to the Shnongpdeng River for some excitement.
Snorkelling, ziplining, kayaking, and cliff jumping may all be combined with an exciting picture shoot.
Spend some time near the river with your loved one.
Arrive in Guwahati and check into your accommodation.
In the evening, take a boat ride on the Brahmaputra River.

days.title: Day 5 : End of the Tour
items: Check out of your hotel with all your lovely memories.
Transfer to Guwahati Airport/Railway Station to begin your journey back home.

items.text: Travellers visiting Meghalaya are required to register on Meghalaya Tourism App and generate an e-invite.
You can download the Meghalaya Tourism App from Google Play Store or App Store.
No reimbursement will be made against missed services.
Travellers are required to show their valid identity cards at the time of check-in to the hotel.
You should not consume alcohol or other intoxicants during your tour.
The vehicle allotted for the tour will be available as per the itinerary and not for general disposal.
In the Northeast, generally, vehicles like Sedan do not have carriers. You are advised to carry one bag per person. Kindly give us prior information in case you have more luggage.

Delay in arrival due to many reasons including flight reschedules shall have to inform to us at an earliest and in case of any sightseeing spot missed due to any delay including spending more time in one sightseeing spot, will not be refundable.

Kajaawa will provide accommodation as per the hotels in the list and in case the listed hotels cannot be provided for any reason like unavailability, scheduled or general maintenance, accident at the hotel, risky road conditions due to bad weather or political disturbance, similar hotels will be provided and you will be informed about the changes in advance.

In Deluxe and Premium Tour Packages, we will generally arrange Deluxe and Premium Hotels but in interior places, we will arrange Homestays, Guest Houses or Standard Hotels as Deluxe and Premium accommodations may not be available in the interiors for any reason.
In case of any unforeseen situations which are beyond our control including bad weather conditions, political disturbance etc., we may change your itinerary or dates of travel.
Travellers may have to bear additional expenses in case of natural calamity including situations like changes in the hotel, changes in tour date etc.
You have to pay 50% of the total tour cost at the time of booking.
After paying 50% you will receive an invoice of your payment and also booking confirmation details containing your detailed travel itinerary and hotel information.
25% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 30 days before the tour starts.
50% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 15-30 days before the tour starts.
100% of the total cost, if the tour is cancelled 0-15 days before the tour starts.
100% of the tour cost has to be paid 1 (one) week before the tour starts.
Refunds will be processed within 7(seven) business days in the customer’s bank account.
